indicator_name: Kazakhstan's imports by partner country (UN Comtrade): consumer goods by BEC and all goods
description: Импорт Казахстана по странам-партнёрам (UN Comtrade): потребительские товары по BEC и все товары
methodology: Item BASKET.M49 partner code (0 = World). CONSUMER = BEC rev.4 112+122+522+61+62+63 (household food and drink, passenger cars, durable/semi-durable/non-durable consumer goods); TOTAL = all goods (HS TOTAL). Reported by Kazakhstan: EAEU partners by survey, China under-recorded against the mirror, partner attribution shifts in 2020-2022. The last three years are re-read on each refresh.
